messages:
Sonia Mehta: Heads up — NorthBridge HW called out a blocker: the NIC driver in their marketplace image surfaces an interactive EULA during install. In our private deploy for AcmeRetail (air-gapped) there is no tty, so install fails. Need arch + legal input.
Marco Ruiz: Confirming. Marketplace listing is northbridge/nic:v2.1 — installer shows vendor EULA prompt. We pushed v2.1 to marketplace last week after partner QA. Hosted customers auto-accept via our relay; private offline installs hit the prompt.
Elena Park: This blocks SI rollout for AcmeRetail next Tues and the joint announcement next Wed. SI needs a workaround ASAP or we pause the announcement.
Jared Cole: Options off the top: (1) vendor provides written consent to pre-accept EULA and allow redistribution in a customer-pinned image (preferred) (2) publish a special "pre-accepted" image for that tenant (requires legal + vendor signoff) (3) provide an installer wrapper that automates acceptance (risky) (4) fall back to older driver v2.0 that doesn't prompt (if vendor permits). Thoughts?
Mari Gomez: Legal: we cannot pre-accept or redistribute driver unless vendor grants explicit redistribution and EULA-waiver for the customer or for Redwood to pre-accept on their behalf. I'll need vendor legal contact and a signed addendum.
Tom Alvarez: From infra side we can pin an image for AcmeRetail quickly if legal signoff exists. Quick command to promote a pinned build: 
``` 
# quick pin (example)
registryctl promote registry/marketplace/northbridge:nic-2.0 registry/private/acmeretail/northbridge:nic-pinned-202603
``` 
That avoids re-building but still requires vendor permission to redistribute.
Priya Singh: Partner (NorthBridge) says vendor legal is reachable today. They asked for a customer note template in case we need to delay announcement. Also asked if there's a safe technical mitigation while legal works the paper.
Sonia Mehta: AcmeRetail oncall asked whether we can fall back to previous marketplace image (v2.0). They prefer that to delaying customer rollout.
Marco Ruiz: v2.0 exists but it's marked legacy and we removed it from active catalog for security patching. We can re-enable and publish a pinned copy for AcmeRetail but vendor still needs to sign redistribution.
Jared Cole: OK — immediate plan: 1) Priya to draft customer-facing hold notice and share with AcmeRetail CSM, 2) Mari to open vendor contact and request redistribution consent, 3) Marco to prepare pinned image artifact and checklist, 4) Tom to stand by to promote once legal signoff arrives. Schedule arch review with SI.
eng-oncall-bot: Created ticket PART-9001 (announcement_hold + SI_blocker) and calendar invite for emergency arch review 2026-03-23 08:00 PST.
Mari Gomez: I'll reach vendor legal now. If they agree, turnaround estimate 48-72h for signed addendum. If they refuse, we need to plan for open-source fallback or longer delay.
Elena Park: AcmeRetail wants timeline and mitigation. Priya — can you share the draft note today?
Priya Singh: I'll post the draft in #partnerships by EOD and ping CSM. Short fill: "AcmeRetail onboarding: temporary hold on joint announcement; technical workaround in progress; expecting update within 72h."
Sonia Mehta: Thanks. Please log decisions and update marketplace onboarding checklist to include "driver license/redistribution required" item so this doesn't blindside SI again.
Jared Cole: Agreed. I'll add an action item to PART-9001: update onboarding doc, include legal gating checklist, and add detection in CI for interactive installers.
Marco Ruiz: Partner will try to get vendor contact and a statement today. I'll update thread when I hear back.
Tom Alvarez: Standing by for promote command and audit log. Keep me in loop for exact image tag to pin.
Sonia Mehta: Closing for now — holding the announcement until we have legal signoff or a confirmed technical fallback. Will reconvene in arch review. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
